description: This page showcases Hydrologic Innovation's portfolio of completed and ongoing engineering projects presented in a case study format. Each project entry summarizes the client, sector, and challenge at a glance. Visitors — particularly government bodies and infrastructure companies — can browse work relevant to their own needs to build confidence in the firm's capabilities.
navigation_note: Accessible from the top navigation bar by clicking 'Projects'. Also reachable from the homepage credibility section and the footer navigation.

list_of_sub_pages.description: This page presents the full case study for a single project using the Problem → Solution → Result narrative structure. It includes project scope, tools and methodologies applied, measurable outcomes, client information, and visuals such as diagrams or GIS maps. This deep-dive view builds credibility with prospective clients evaluating the firm for similar infrastructure challenges.
list_of_sub_pages.navigation_note: Opens when a visitor clicks a project card or 'View Case Study' button on the Projects list page. Back button or breadcrumb returns to the Projects portfolio overview.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch paginated list of project case studies with filters for sector and project type

request_payload_ui_passing.page: From the pagination control — current page number (starts at 1), incremented or decremented by the pagination component below the project cards grid
request_payload_ui_passing.limit: From the page size selector or fixed default (e.g. 9 cards per page) — sent as a constant with each paginated request
request_payload_ui_passing.sector: From a filter dropdown above the project cards list populated with hardcoded sector options: ['Urban Infrastructure', 'Government', 'Real Estate', 'Industrial', 'Agriculture'] — empty/null means all sectors
request_payload_ui_passing.project_type: From a filter dropdown above the project cards list populated with hardcoded project type options: ['Hydraulic Modeling', 'WTP Design', 'STP Design', 'GIS Integration', 'Environmental Consulting', 'Irrigation'] — empty/null means all types
